Browser wait strategy 'fixed' waits for a specific duration after page navigation

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"browser\":{\"extra_wait\":100,\"mode\":\"always\",\"wait\":\"fixed\"}}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.browserUsed())
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
```
